title: Chapter 336: Sifang City Vs Undead Giant Sword
content:
Chapter 336: Sifang City Vs Undead Giant Sword

In this way, one day later, all the undead army was teleported outside Nanxuan Mansion through the altar.

The main force of this siege was the Blood Legion and the Purple Flame Legion of the undead army.

Directed by the Black Dragon King himself.

The elite main force has reached more than 800,000 people. Counting ordinary skeleton warriors, the total number exceeds 2 million, which is huge.

But Bond Zhao still looked calm and calm.

Although there are many enemies, Zhao Bond has gained a new trump card, so this battle is still certain.

The war drums beat, and the undead begin to attack.

Having experienced previous battles to defend the city, Wang Shuo and others were already quite experienced.

The generals at all levels in Wana Town were well-organized and commanded decisively. The defenders of Nanxuan Mansion repelled several attacks by the undead one after another.

In the evening, both sides stopped fighting. The undead consumed tens of thousands of skeleton warriors, but did not break through the protective barrier of Nanxuan Mansion.

The siege of the undead is different from the siege of human soldiers. It relies entirely on the large number of skeletons to charge in a swarm. Therefore, if the degree of brutality is very high, the casualties will naturally be much greater.

On the second and third days, the same was true, and the entire battle entered a relatively relaxed stage.

Obviously, the undead did not launch a violent attack.

I don’t know what the Black Dragon King is thinking. Is he also planning some big move, an attack similar to destroying the protective shield of Shanhai City?

Wang Shuo was a little worried, but there was nothing he could do.

In this way, the relatively peaceful attack lasted for nearly ten days.

On this day, the drums of the undead on the opposite side continued to beat.

The senior officials of Nanxuan Mansion all felt something unusual.

Zhao Bangde and Zhu Dongheng stood on the city gate tower, looking at the mobilization of the undead army, and their expressions became solemn.

The mountain rain is about to come, and the death aura on the altars in all directions is so strong that it cannot be melted away.

The Black Dragon King transformed into a giant dragon, flew into the air, controlled the death energy, and gathered it into a giant sword, hanging over Nanxuan Mansion.

When Zhao Bond saw this, he took out the "Sifang City" prop without hesitation.

He raised his right hand and gently threw the Sifang City into the air. The prop that looked like a small city continued to expand in the wind, and finally turned into a golden mask that overlapped with the entire city of Nanxuan Mansion.

In an instant, the entire city seemed to be bathed in golden light.

At this moment, the giant sword above the city shot straight into the sky, and after a few breaths, it fell from the sky again.

This blow carried infinite power, and the color of the world changed.

Everyone had their hearts in their throats and felt extremely uneasy.

If the protective shield is broken, this battle will most likely be lost.

"Bang."

A huge mushroom cloud rose, and the huge shock caused by the explosion caused countless human soldiers guarding the city to fall.

The huge air wave spread to dozens of miles away.

The skeleton warriors nearby were blown away dozens of meters.

Even the two elites of the Undead Legion, who were standing five or six miles away, were unsteady and staggering.

Wait until the explosion is over.

The human soldiers were the first to burst into cheers.

Countless soldiers were extremely excited and hugged each other to celebrate, as if they had won the battle.

The Black Dragon King snorted coldly when he saw that Nanxuan Mansion's defense had not been destroyed.

"Hmph, attack!"

Although the defense is still there, the arrow is on the string and has to be fired.

The soldiers on the city wall were still cheering. When they saw the undead starting to attack, their expressions suddenly changed.

The commanders began to shout loudly: "Meet the enemy and fight!"
